Hana Lee: Follow-up from the billing postmortem — we saw late ingest + duplicate token attribution affecting a small subset of invoices. Need owners for: (A) token reconciliation job, (B) adjustment ledger writes (append-only), and (C) customer-facing credits.

Arjun Malhotra: I'll own the reconciliation job. Plan: compute canonical token totals per invoice window and emit compensating entries. Will add leader election and a dry-run mode.

Hana Lee: Please include an operator audit trail (job_run_id, operator, PR link). Keep the job reversible by writing adjustments rather than mutating ledgers.

BillingBot: ALERT: Ticket BILL-2440 created. 25 invoices flagged; estimated exposure $3,400. Suggested workflow: dry-run CSV -> legal review -> apply adjustments.

Arjun Malhotra: Sample SQL for dry-run:
```sql
SELECT invoice_id, customer_id, SUM(token_delta) AS delta_tokens
FROM usage_aggregate
WHERE event_ts >= '2026-03-14' AND event_ts < '2026-03-15'
GROUP BY invoice_id, customer_id
HAVING ABS(SUM(token_delta)) > 750;
```
Will upload results to BILL-2440.

Victor Grant: I'll own the customer credits and comms. Need the signed dry-run CSV and a summary table (invoice_id, pre_tokens, post_tokens, credit_amount).

OpsClaire: Ops will enable a 4-minute post-deploy write-throttle and add a retry-fingerprint metric. Tracked in ENGOPS-1120.

Hana Lee: Owners & due dates (confirm here):
- Arjun Malhotra  reconciliation job + dry-run  due 2026-03-18
- Victor Grant  credit memos + customer emails  due 2026-03-20
- OpsClaire  deploy throttle + metrics  due 2026-03-16
Please ack in-thread and post PR/ticket links when ready.

Arjun Malhotra: ACK. Dry-run CSV will be uploaded to BILL-2440 by EOD. PR will include idempotent write semantics.

Victor Grant: ACK. Will prep templates and route to legal on receipt.

BillingBot: BILL-2440 checklist updated: dry-run pending, legal review pending, apply adjustments pending.

Hana Lee: Thanks. Quick operational notes: run canary on top-10 customers first, keep a 24h rollback window, and tag all adjustments with job_run_id and checksum. We'll reconvene after dry-run verification. :white_check_mark:
